title: Asteria-MC
description: Are you looking for a stable and fun place to start your adventure? Join us for a deep dive into a game where community and cool chips meet classic survival!
body:
Are you looking for a stable and fun place to start your adventure? Join us for a deep dive into a game where community and cool chips meet classic survival!

Our key features:

Advanced economy: Earn money, trade with others and dominate the server market!

Work system: Choose your profession! Become a miner, lumberjack or hunter to get rewards.

Clans and Alliances: Create your own clan, invite friends and fight for power.

Safe private territories: Easily protect your buildings with our griffer protection system.

Voice chat (Plasma Voice): Communicate with players nearby in real time for better immersion.

Funny mechanics: Do you want to have fun? You can ride on the heads of other players, use emotions!

And every week we organize events, and much more!
